WITH color_avgs AS (
  SELECT p.product_color AS product_color,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) AS color_avg
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(color_avg) AS overall_avg FROM color_avgs
),
kept AS (
  SELECT c.product_color, c.color_avg, c.color_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM color_avgs c CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE c.color_avg > o.overall_avg
),
last_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(color_avg) AS kept_avg FROM kept
)
SELECT k.product_color, k.color_avg, k.excess, k.color_avg - l.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg
FROM kept k
JOIN last_avg l ON l.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
WHERE k.color_avg > l.kept_avg
ORDER BY k.product_color
